stem: Which conclusion did the guideline panel reach about the effect of sealants on occlusal pit-and-fissure carious lesions in children and adolescents?

options.text: Sealants prevent new occlusal lesions but cannot arrest lesions that have already started.
Sealants are effective in permanent molars, but evidence of benefit in primary molars is lacking.
Sealants effectively prevent and arrest occlusal lesions in both primary and permanent molars, compared with no sealant or fluoride varnish.
Sealants perform no better than leaving the occlusal surface unsealed.
